name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and previous messages in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to maintain interest and encourage further dialogue.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow of ideas and clarity of the response within the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in introducing new ideas or perspectives.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates the brevity of the response while still conveying the intended message effectively.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the degree to which the response demonstrates understanding and consideration of the other participant's feelings or opinions.

name: Fact Relevance
description: Evaluates the appropriateness and correctness of any factual information included in the response.
